features.title: Designed for productive meetings, Sync Conference tables combine sleek form, sturdy build, and smart cable access to keep teams connected.
features.text: Designed to fit every modern space

features.title: Neutral tones and streamlined lines let this Sync table blend seamlessly into any space, from creative hubs to executive boardrooms.
Designed for group productivity, the spacious surface ensures comfortable seating for 6–10 people during meetings or presentations.
Angled metal legs give the table a striking silhouette while ensuring strength and stability for everyday use.
Curved edges reduce risks in busy spaces while adding a sleek, modern look that complements any office interior.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
